Bootstrap an MBMM gate threshold

Source: R/pd50.R
mbmm_bootstrap_gate_threshold.Rd

Estimates a fitted gate threshold and its uncertainty by resampling subjects, refitting the MBMM gate, and recalculating the threshold in each bootstrap sample.

Usage

mbmm_bootstrap_gate_threshold(
  logL,
  formula,
  data,
  focal,
  classes = NULL,
  hold_at = list(),
  level = 0.5,
  center = 0,
  scale = 1,
  transform = c("identity", "log10", "log"),
  observed_range = NULL,
  n_boot = 1000,
  conf = 0.95,
  ridge = 1e-04,
  penalty = "ridge",
  id_col = "id",
  seed = NULL,
  maxit = 4000,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

logL

Data.frame containing the class-conditional log-likelihood columns used by mbmm_fit_gate.

formula

One-sided gate-model formula.

data

Subject-level covariate data.frame.

focal

Name of the continuous covariate whose threshold is requested.

classes

Optional latent-class order passed to mbmm_fit_gate.

hold_at

Named list fixing all other covariates in the gate formula.

level

Gate probability at which the threshold is calculated.

center

Center used to standardize the focal covariate.

scale

Scale used to standardize the focal covariate.

transform

Transformation applied before standardization. One of "identity", "log10", or "log".

observed_range

Optional two-element numeric vector giving the observed range of the focal covariate on the fitted model scale. By default, the range is calculated from data[[focal]].

n_boot

Number of subject-level bootstrap samples.

conf

Confidence level for the percentile interval.

ridge

Ridge parameter passed to mbmm_fit_gate.

penalty

Either "ridge" or "none".

id_col

Subject-ID column in data.

seed

Optional bootstrap seed.

maxit

Maximum gate optimizer iterations.

verbose

Print bootstrap progress.

Value

An object of class "mbmm_threshold_summary" containing the point estimate, percentile confidence interval, bootstrap estimates, bootstrap success rate, and extrapolation percentage.

Details

The function reports thresholds both on the covariate scale used in the gate model and, optionally, on the original biomarker scale.

A bootstrap estimate is classified as extrapolated when its model-scale threshold lies outside the observed range of the focal gate covariate.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
result <- mbmm_bootstrap_gate_threshold(
  logL = logL,
  formula = ~ biomarker_z,
  data = biomarker_data,
  focal = "biomarker_z",
  classes = c("productive", "nonestablishment"),
  center = mean(log10(biomarker_data$biomarker)),
  scale = sd(log10(biomarker_data$biomarker)),
  transform = "log10",
  n_boot = 1000,
  seed = 1
)

result
} # }
